name: MessageList
usage: AI chat conversations, long chat histories with earlier messages loaded on scroll

props.name: getKey
props.description: Stable key of a message (such as its ID); keeps the position when earlier messages are inserted.

props.name: renderItem
props.description:
Renders a message, usually a Message. A message is rendered again when the item, its index or this function
changes: an inline function updates every visible message on each render, a stable function (`useCallback`)
must change when other data it reads changes.

props.name: estimateSize
props.description: Estimated height of a message in pixels, used until it is measured.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Number of messages rendered outside the visible area on each side (overscan).

props.name: onReachStart
props.description:
Called while the person scrolls near the top (within half the visible height), to load earlier messages.
Insert them at the start of `items`; the visible messages stay in place. Leave it out when there is nothing
more to load.

props.name: loadingStart
props.description: Shows "Loading earlier messages" at the top and stops calling `onReachStart` while true.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when there are no messages, such as a welcome text with PromptSuggestions.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the list; "Conversation" by default.

modes.title: Finished messages (default)
modes.description: A list without a reply being generated, such as a history. Nothing is announced to screen readers.

props.name: streaming
props.description:
Set while the last message is being generated: the list is marked `aria-busy`, and when it turns off, screen
readers hear `getAnnouncement` of the last message once (instead of every piece as it arrives).

props.name: getAnnouncement
props.description: With `streaming`: the text that screen readers hear when the reply is finished.

modes.title: Streamed replies: `streaming`
modes.description:
The last message can be generated while it is shown. Screen readers are not interrupted by every piece: the list is
`aria-busy` while `streaming`, and when it turns off they hear the text that `getAnnouncement` returns for the
last message, once. The text comes from the data, so the finished reply is announced even when it is scrolled out
of view and not rendered, and two identical replies in a row are both announced.

props.name: streaming
props.description:
Set while the last message is being generated: the list is marked `aria-busy`, and when it turns off, screen
readers hear `getAnnouncement` of the last message once (instead of every piece as it arrives).

props.name: getAnnouncement
props.description:
The text that screen readers hear once when the reply is finished (`streaming` turns off), for the last
message: usually its text, or a short note for a reply that failed or was stopped. For a reply in Markdown, give
the text without the markup when you have it, since screen readers may read the markup characters. Return
`undefined` to announce nothing.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
One thousand messages, of which only the visible ones are rendered. "Ask" adds a question and streams a reply
(a simulated endpoint read with useStream): the list follows the growing reply. Scroll up while it streams to
pause following; "Back to latest" brings you back.

examples.name: Empty
examples.title: Empty conversation
examples.description: `empty` is shown while there are no messages, for example a welcome text with suggestions.

examples.name: LoadEarlier
examples.title: Loading earlier messages
examples.description:
Scrolling up near the top calls `onReachStart`; the earlier messages are inserted at the start and the visible
ones stay in place. `loadingStart` shows the indicator meanwhile.

examples.name: Assistant
examples.title: AI assistant
examples.description:
The AI components together: the reply streams in as Markdown with citations, Reasoning shows the thinking step
before the first words arrive, Sources lists the references once the reply is done, and the latest reply can be
copied, retried and rated. The input stops the reply while it is generating.
